exposure: Mothers with no or short education
Lack of support from health care professionals
cohort: The study included 1437 mothers with full-term singleton infants who responded to a postal survey.
finding: Up to 40% of mothers experienced early breastfeeding problems, which were associated with maternal, infant, and support factors, as well as primiparity, lower self-efficacy, and lower self-perceived knowledge of breastfeeding.
